variants.prompt: Frame the charismatic redhead in an extreme close-up, the camera lens nearly touching her flushed cheeks, capturing every detail of her alluring features - the gentle curve of her smile, the sparkle of her vibrant green eyes, the tantalizing swell of her décolletage above the neckline of her sheer black lingerie, the soft, parted lips and delicate freckles on her nose, the shallow depth of field blurring her surroundings, focusing the viewer's attention solely on her captivating, seductive presence.
